CTP 返回错误 {code}；核对账户信息后重新连接。: CTP returned error {code}; check the account details and connect again.
{n} 笔已记录的委托没有出现在券商回报中：{ids}。它们不会被重发，并继续占: {n} recorded orders are missing from broker reports: {ids}. They are never resent and still count against the working-order limit; verify them with the broker.
券商对本账户实际收取的保证金率与手续费；多空保证金不同时取较高者。: Margin and commission rates the broker actually charges this account; when long and short margins differ, the higher one is used.
限价须在涨跌停范围内，且与券商最新价（当日无成交时为昨结算价）的偏离不超过该比例: Limit prices must stay within the exchange's price limits and within this fraction of the broker's latest price (the pre-settlement price before the first trade), e.g. 0.02 for 2%. Each order queries the market once before it is sent, taking about a second.
真实资金账户：授权后的委托可能产生真实成交与盈亏。: Real funds account: authorized orders can cause real executions and gains or losses.
请向开户机构核对账号及前置地址。环境由你确认，系统无法自动验证资金性质。: Verify the account and front address with your broker. You confirm the environment; the system cannot verify whether funds are real.
创建账户不会登录或发送委托。下一步确认环境、连接并授权。: Creation does not log in or submit orders. Next, confirm the environment, connect and authorize trading.
我确认使用账户 {user} 向上方柜台发送委托: I authorize account {user} to submit orders to the broker above
我已核对账户与柜台环境: I have verified the account and broker environment
已标记为 CTP 仿真；委托仍会发送到上方柜台，请确认地址正确。: Marked as CTP simulation. Orders will still be sent to the broker above; verify the address.
在券商端确认某笔委托不存在后，可将其标为已核实，它不再占用在途委托额度。: After confirming at the broker that an order does not exist, mark it verified; it stops counting against the working-order limit.
断开账户会退出柜台连接，已有委托不会自动撤销。: Disconnecting the account logs out of the counter; existing orders are not cancelled automatically.
保留历史政策与命令。现有持仓和在途委托仍计入风险；变更后断开连接，需重新登录、同: Historical policies and commands are retained. Existing positions and working orders still count as exposure. Applying a policy disconnects the account; sign in, synchronize and authorize again.
新增合约前，请在行情页取得合约目录；现有合约仍可调整风险限额。: Load the contract catalog in Market before adding contracts. Risk limits for existing contracts can still be changed.
我确认应用上述政策并重新登录: I confirm this policy and will sign in again
柜台回报队列已满，新增报单已停止。请重新连接并核对账户；已有委托不会自动撤销。: The broker report queue is full and new orders are blocked. Reconnect and reconcile the account; existing orders are not automatically cancelled.
账户已连接。此窗口尚未核对柜台环境，核对后才能授权和下单。: The account is connected. This window has not confirmed the counter environment; confirm it before authorizing or placing orders.
按行情填入限价: Fill the limit price from the market
连接柜台后可查询账户费率。: Connect to the counter to query the account's rates.
委托先写入本机交易记录再发送；断线后不会自动重发。: Orders are recorded locally before they are sent and are never resent after a disconnect.
授权长期有效，断线重连和换交易日后不需要再次授权；撤销授权、修改风控政策或交易服: The authorization lasts across reconnects and trading days; it ends when you revoke it, change the risk policy or the trading service restarts.
尚未核对已知成交: Known fills are not yet reconciled
资金、持仓、订单和成交可能来自不同时间；同步完成时间不代表原子账本或完整历史。: Funds, positions, orders and trades may be observed at different times. Synchronization completion is neither an atomic ledger cut nor complete history.
账户信息来自交易服务配置，只能在交易主机上设置。: Account details come from the trading service configuration and are set on the trading host.
账户与柜台环境由交易服务配置，Terminal 只配置风控。: The trading service configures the account and environment. Terminal configures the risk policy.
交易服务使用主机本地凭据登录柜台。: The trading service signs in using credentials stored on its host.
行情服务设置文件无法读取，已保留原文件供检查。: The Market settings file cannot be read. The original file has been preserved.
尚未填写行情服务地址。: No Market address has been configured.
服务尚未连接柜台: Market is not connected to the broker
关闭此连接不影响服务录制或其他客户端。: Closing this connection does not affect recording or other clients.
连接远程行情服务以查看市场。: Connect to the remote Market service to view quotes.
连接远程行情服务后可选择合约；柜台凭据在服务主机配置。: Connect to Market to select contracts. Broker credentials are configured on the service host.
发布只安装代码，不启动策略或授权交易。: Publishing installs code. It does not start a strategy or authorize trading.
此账户尚未安装策略包。: No strategy packages are installed for this account.
参数名不能为空或重复。: Parameter names must be nonempty and unique.
整数参数必须是完整的十进制整数。: Integer parameters must be whole decimal integers.
整数参数超出范围。: Integer parameter is out of range.
小数参数必须是有限数值。: Decimal parameters must be finite numbers.
请先连接并同步账户，再启动实例。: Connect and synchronize the account before starting an instance.
账户政策已变化，请返回重新核对配置。: The account policy changed. Go back and review the configuration again.
请选择主机上已发布的版本。: Select a version published on this host.
请选择账户政策内的 1–20 个实际合约。: Select 1–20 native contracts allowed by the account policy.
按策略参数名填写；未覆盖项采用包内默认值。: Use the parameter names from the strategy. Other parameters retain their package defaults.
策略输出权重，设置权重预算: The strategy outputs weights; set weight budgets
权重预算按倍数填写，例如 1 表示一倍权益；预算不替代账户风控限额。: Enter weight budgets as multiples: 1 means one times equity. Budgets do not replace account risk limits.
状态未确认，以下为上次已知状态。请读取主机状态后再启动或发布。: Status is unconfirmed; showing the last known state. Read host state before starting or publishing.
正在读取交易主机策略状态。: Reading strategy state from the trading host.
预热是否完成由策略按参数和实际收到的数据判断；批次数不是预热百分比。: The strategy determines readiness from its parameters and received data. The batch count is not a warmup percentage.
本批没有可执行目标: This batch has no executable targets
目标不代表成交；实际持仓和委托请查看下方账户记录。: Targets are not fills. See the account records below for actual positions and orders.
关闭 Terminal 不影响已授权交易。停止策略会尝试撤销其未终结委托，保留持: Closing Terminal does not affect authorized trading. Stopping a strategy attempts to cancel its outstanding orders and preserves positions and account authorization.
确认停止实例 {id} 并尝试撤单？此操作不会平仓。: Stop instance {id} and attempt to cancel its orders? This does not close positions.
策略状态不可用，请重新读取。: Strategy status is unavailable. Read the host again.
启动从空窗口现场预热，或从已结束实例的记录恢复。启动不授权；账户未授权时，就绪目: Each start warms up from an empty window, or resumes from the record of an ended instance. Starting does not authorize trading; while the account is not authorized, ready targets are recorded but not executed.
实例 ID 不可复用；重新启动须使用新 ID。: Instance IDs cannot be reused; a restart needs a new ID.
从实例 {id} 的记录恢复: Resume from the record of instance {id}
已暂停新增：目标只减仓。: New positions paused: targets only reduce.
确认对实例 {id} 的合约平仓？实例会暂停新增并继续运行。: Close the positions of instance {id}? The instance pauses new positions and keeps running.
交易服务连接或记录状态不确定，界面显示的是最后读到的状态。断线时的命令不会自动重: The trading service connection or record state is uncertain; the page shows the last state read. Commands are never resent after a disconnect.
Terminal 没有策略目录：从项目启动时是项目里的 research/。: The Terminal has no strategy directory: run from the project, it is research/ of the project.
在设置里添加交易连接后，这里显示账户、委托和策略。: Add a trading connection in Settings to see accounts, orders and strategies here.
